pr_title: Fix intent loading and incorporate unmatched entities more
pr_body:
<!--

## Breaking change
<!--

  to tell them what breaks, how to make it work again and why we did this.

-->


## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->


## Type of change
<!--
  What type of change does your PR introduce to Home Assistant?
  NOTE: Please, check only 1! box!
  If your PR requires multiple boxes to be checked, you'll most likely need to
  split it into multiple PRs. This makes things easier and faster to code review.
-->
The initial goal of this PR was to fix https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/107522 but more was added on as additional problems were discovered.

This PR now:

- Bumps hassil to 1.5.3: https://github.com/home-assistant/hassil/compare/v1.5.2...1.5.3
- Commits to a **single language variant** for all domains and custom sentences when loading intents
- Loads sentences for all domains so errors can still be reported
- Prefers to report missing entities vs. missing areas, etc.
- Augments the Assist debug tool with more information, such as the sentence template that was matched

## Intent loading

When loading intents, Assist will try different variations for a language code (`en-US`, `en_US`, `en`, etc). Previously, this was done **independently for each domain**, meaning `pt` and `pt-br` intents could get mixed due to differing domain support. When mixing, only one set of common rules would loaded, so this caused errors due to missing lists and expansion rules.

Now Assist will commit to a language variant upfront when loading intents and custom sentences, so mixing will never occur. Additionally, sentences from all domains are now loaded to enable better error messages. For example, saying "set my light to red" will now report "No device or entity named my light" even if HA does not contain any lights.

### Debug tool

The internal Assist debug tool WS API was augmented with some new fields:

* `match` - true when the sentence fully matched a sentence template, false when incomplete
* `sentence_template` - text of the sentence template that was matched (or the best guess)
* `unmatched_slots` - name/value of the best guess for the intent slots (when `match = false`)

For example, the sentence "turn on missing light" returns:

```yaml
intent:
  name: HassTurnOn
slots: {}
details: {}
targets: {}
match: false
sentence_template: <turn> on (<area> <name>|<name> [in <area>])
unmatched_slots:
  name: missing light
```

review_comments: Don’t we still need this for custom components

Custom components can supply intents, but not sentences so we should still be good. If you have a sentence that uses an intent from a custom component, the sentence will get loaded regardless of whether the custom component is loaded or not.
Let’s cover this in a test
Good thing you suggested this. I had a bug :D
If we're going to load all languages at once, let's change the intent package to only ship a single JSON file per language
OK, I've made a note of this for a future PR
